preconditions.description: n is the number of rounds (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5), and k is the maximum number of outcome changes sponsors can make (1 ≤ k ≤ min(2^n - 1, 10^9)).

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum possible winner's number modulo 10^9 + 7, achievable regardless of sponsors' changes.

postconditions.expression: min_possible_winner(n, k) == min({w for w in range(1, 2**n + 1) if can_ensure_winner(n, k, w)})
postconditions.description: The output is the smallest integer w in [1, 2^n] such that Madoka can ensure w wins the tournament despite at most k sponsor changes.
